text.p: IFR Systems Inc Friday said its board of directors approved a quarterly dividend on its common stock and declared a dividend of $0.05 a share to be paid on September 12, to shareholders of record on August 29.

"This quarterly dividend signals our confidence in IFR's future growth," said President and Chief Executive Officer Alfred Hunt III. He noted that the company's acquisition program, coupled with appropriate capital spending, will not be affected by the timely payment of this dividend to shareholders.

IFR Systems, through its RF and Fiber Optics divisions, is a leading designer and manufacturer of electronic test instruments for wireless and fiber optic communications, optical fibers, avionics and general test and measurement applications.
